changes: Replaced spawnSync with promisified execFile and awaited subprocess calls; captures stdout/stderr, exit status, errors, signal, and enforces per-command timeout while leaving the in-process fixture event loop responsive.
Writes the candidate manifest with dirty-worktree status, base commit, and frozen snapshot digest before candidate assertions.
Restricts packaged-byte checks to SKILL.md, references/**, scripts/**, assets/**, LICENSE, and NOTICE.
Compares transformed output bytes for all four configured workflows across all four agents (16 comparisons), recording each path, format, byte count, and SHA-256.
Includes fixture request logs and subprocess evidence in both success and failure receipts.

Corrected the isolated consumer .skillsrc MCP block to provide required disabled scope and prompted fields. Added a check for CLI sync's failure message because the first run returned exit status zero while logging a configuration failure.
Allowed only the three hosts approved by network-preload and fixture-routed to loopback; the second attempt showed this fixture legitimately receives requests from more than api.github.com.

behavioral_attempts.result: FAIL before package assertions: consumer config omitted required mcp.scope and mcp.prompted; CLI logged Sync failed but returned exit 0.
FAIL at host assertion after sync and verify succeeded; the assertion incorrectly allowed only api.github.com.

authorization: Existing parent authorization for the local fixture consumer smoke remains in force.
